comment.narrative: Result 2023 During the course of the project 287 101 from last year is included municipal representative 32 state representatives and 43 regional CSO representatives participated in capacitybuilding events throughout Georgia. These initiatives focused on enhancing their understanding of GenderBased Violence GBV and Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights SRHR issues thereby empowering them to refine mechanisms to combat GBV and provide improved support to its victims. A total of 22 mobilizers received specialized training in reproductive health and sexual rights in 2022 while 18 6 is from last year psychologists from subgrantee organizations expanded their skills in service provision. In total 402 individuals participated in these capacitybuilding events contributing to a more informed and skilled network dedicated to addressing GBV and promoting SRHR across the region.
